from statemachine import State, StateMachine

class Machine(StateMachine):
    first = State(initial=True, data={'items': []})
    second = State()
    go = first.to(second)
    back = second.to(first)

m = Machine()
assert m.get_state_data(Machine.first) == {'items': []}
m.get_state_data(Machine.first)['items'].append(1)
m.go()
assert m.get_state_data(Machine.first) is None
m.back()
assert m.get_state_data(Machine.first) == {'items': []}
